template.name: Stochastic Failure Swing
template.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,{p0}), {p1}) and bars_since(rsi(close,{p2}) < 30) < 10 and close > donchian_low_prev(low,10)
template.notes: Stochastic %K/%D are unavailable, so RSI(14) supplies the oversold 20 reading and its recross above 30, with the higher low represented by price holding above the prior 10-bar low and bars_since giving the documented failure-swing look-back. The documented 2% stop is encoded; the 15-minute candle type and the prior-swing-level exit are approximated by the RSI 50 mirror.
